name: Copyable identifiers
rule: Give people a one-action way to copy any ID or reference they must quote, with brief confirmation that it copied.

leaders.note: Linear has one-shortcut commands to copy an issue's ID and its git branch name, so people can paste identifiers elsewhere without selecting text.
The Dashboard has a single shortcut that copies the ID of the object being viewed, since people use IDs to look up records and match customers to payments.
